sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的很喜欢这个故事。

sentences.zh: 告诉我，你有什么招数能让女士对你感兴趣？

sentences.en: First, you have ridiculous pickup lines like the movie in the box.
sentences.zh: 首先，你用那种荒谬的搭讪台词，比如那个盒子里的电影。

sentences.en: And then you go up to someone you don't really know and scratch their back.
sentences.zh: 然后你走到一个不太熟的人面前，去抓人家的背。

sentences.en: Are you crazy?
sentences.zh: 你疯了吗？

sentences.en: Well, she said she had an itch she couldn't reach.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她说她有个地方痒，自己够不着。

sentences.en: She did, but I don't think that was an invitation.
sentences.zh: 她是说了，但我觉得那并不是邀请。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不是。

sentences.en: Yeah, that wasn't an invitation, Andy.
sentences.zh: 没错，那不是邀请，安迪。

sentences.en: Don't go scratching people's backs unless you're invited to scratch their back.
sentences.zh: 除非别人邀请你，否则别去抓别人的背。

sentences.en: And Angela definitely does not seem interested.
sentences.zh: 而且安吉拉看起来显然一点也不感兴趣。

sentences.en: And then there's a scene, Jenna, that I love.
sentences.zh: 然后有一个场景，珍娜，我特别喜欢。

sentences.en: It's something our show does that I love.
sentences.zh: 这是我们剧里我非常喜欢的一种处理方式。

sentences.en: It's never explained.
sentences.zh: 它从不解释。

sentences.en: It's just Dwight and Andy standing outside the men's room.
sentences.zh: 就是德怀特和安迪站在男厕所外面。

sentences.en: Dwight is clearly on guard.
sentences.zh: 德怀特显然是在站岗。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: By his whole physical posture.
sentences.zh: 从他整个身体姿态就能看出来。

sentences.en: So we're just left to assume pizza guys in there on his bathroom break.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能假设那个送披萨的在里面上厕所。

sentences.en: He's been led in there.
sentences.zh: 他被带进去了。

sentences.en: And Andy and Dwight have this whole conversation outside the men's room.
sentences.zh: 然后安迪和德怀特在男厕所外进行了那番对话。

sentences.en: And at one point, Dwight kicks open the door and says, unless you're going number two,
sentences.zh: 有一刻，德怀特踢开门说，除非你在上大号，

sentences.en: you've got about 15 seconds left or something to that effect.
sentences.zh: 否则你只剩下大约15秒了，大概就是这个意思。

sentences.en: And I just have to say, I really loved Rain's choice here.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，我真的很喜欢雷恩在这里的选择。

sentences.en: Like the way he kicked the door.
sentences.zh: 比如他踹门的方式。

sentences.en: He looked very official.
sentences.zh: 他看起来非常一本正经。

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: And Rain, I feel like his performance in the scene is so great.
sentences.zh: 而且雷恩，我觉得他在这一幕里的表演太棒了。

sentences.en: It's all these little moments.
sentences.zh: 全靠这些小细节。

sentences.en: He's slightly like pleased, right?
sentences.zh: 他有点暗自窃喜，对吧？

sentences.en: That Angela has rejected Andy.
sentences.zh: 因为安吉拉拒绝了安迪。

sentences.en: He's still crestfallen.
sentences.zh: 但他依然很沮丧。

sentences.en: He's still upset that Andy wants to continue to pursue her.
sentences.zh: 他还是对安迪想要继续追求安吉拉感到心烦。

sentences.en: But yet he has a job to do.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，他还有工作要做。

sentences.en: And that is to make sure the pizza guy doesn't escape.
sentences.zh: 那就是确保送披萨的家伙跑不掉。

sentences.en: Well, the Dwight character is such a great character because he is so invested and committed to being Michael's number two.
sentences.zh: 嗯，德怀特这个角色之所以这么棒，是因为他全心全意地致力于成为迈克尔的二把手。

sentences.en: So much so that in a minute, he's going to be interrogating this pizza kid.
sentences.zh: 甚至到了下一分钟，他就要去审问这个送披萨的孩子了。

sentences.en: And Michael is now going to suddenly realize what they've done, that they have kidnapped someone.
sentences.zh: 而迈克尔现在突然意识到他们做了什么，他们绑架了别人。

sentences.en: And he starts freaking out.
sentences.zh: 他开始惊慌失措。

sentences.en: And it takes Dwight a second because he was so committed to the other choice.
sentences.zh: 德怀特反应了一会儿，因为他之前太执着于之前的选择了。

sentences.en: But then he becomes just as committed to the new choice.
sentences.zh: 但随后他同样全心全意地投入到了新的选择中。

sentences.en: And he pays for all the pizza.
sentences.zh: 他还付了所有的披萨钱。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's so loyal to Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，他对迈克尔太忠诚了。

sentences.en: And it is a little bit like creepy.
sentences.zh: 这甚至有点让人毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: It's it reminded me a little bit of like Lord of the Flies.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了一点《蝇王》的感觉。

sentences.en: Like, you know, it's like all of a sudden, you know, when people follow someone who they shouldn't be following.
sentences.zh: 就像，你知道，当人们盲目追随一个不该追随的人时，突然之间会发生什么。

sentences.en: And then where does that lead them?
sentences.zh: 那会把他们引向何方？

sentences.en: And what are they capable of?
sentences.zh: 他们又会做出什么事来？

sentences.en: What was Dwight going to continue to do to this pizza guy?
sentences.zh: 德怀特原本打算对这个送披萨的人继续做什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's such a crazy storyline.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这剧情真是太疯狂了。

sentences.en: We talked about it, and I feel like so much of it really hinges on Kevin's great performance.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过，我觉得这很大程度上取决于凯文出色的表演。

sentences.en: Yes, I absolutely agree.
sentences.zh: 是的，我完全同意。

sentences.en: He was perfect all throughout the scenes.
sentences.zh: 他在整个场景中的表现都堪称完美。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we just asked him if he had any memories from his time on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们问过他，在剧组期间有什么难忘的回忆。

sentences.en: And here's what he had to say.
sentences.zh: 以下是他的回答。

sentences.en: My biggest memory or takeaway from the entire experience period was honestly the generosity and the kindness from everybody.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我整个经历中最深刻的记忆或收获，就是大家表现出的慷慨和友善。

sentences.en: Everybody went out of their way.
sentences.zh: 每个人都特别照顾我。

sentences.en: To accept me, to welcome me with open arMs.
sentences.zh: 接纳我，张开双臂欢迎我。

sentences.en: I sat with, you know, a lot of the cast for lunch every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天午餐都和很多演员坐在一起。

sentences.en: I think they, you know, I was totally a fish out of water, and I think everybody could see that.
sentences.zh: 我想他们，你知道，我当时完全是个局外人，我想每个人都看得出来。

sentences.en: And it's one of those things where you come on set, they welcome you to set in rehearsal, and everybody cheers.
sentences.zh: 那种感觉就是，当你来到片场，他们在排练时欢迎你，每个人都在欢呼。

sentences.en: And that is something that I've taken with me.
sentences.zh: 那是我一直铭记在心的事。

sentences.en: And I remember going into Glee, how it hit me at some point of like, oh, I'm now in their position as the person who's on this show every week.
sentences.zh: 我记得后来去拍《欢乐合唱团》时，我突然意识到，哦，我现在处于他们的位置了，成了每周都在剧组里的人。

sentences.en: And when people come on, I need to treat them how the office people treated me.
sentences.zh: 当有新人加入时，我需要像《办公室》的伙伴们对待我那样对待他们。

sentences.en: And whenever I would see people, I'd see Kate, I would see Mindy out at events or whatever it may be, and everyone was just still so nice to me.
sentences.zh: 每当我见到他们，见到凯特，见到敏迪，在活动或其他场合，每个人对我依然非常友善。

sentences.en: And they'd come up and be like, oh, I'm so happy.
sentences.zh: 他们会走过来对我说，哦，我真为你高兴。

sentences.en: Like, the Glee is doing so well.
sentences.zh: 《欢乐合唱团》做得真好。

sentences.en: And it was one of those things where me coming on to a show that was so big, and all these people were so very famous and successful,
sentences.zh: 当时我加入了一部非常火的剧，而这些人又如此出名且成功，

sentences.en: that even though I was now on a show that was successful, I still felt very much like the fan.
sentences.zh: 尽管我现在也身处一部成功的剧里，但我依然感觉自己像个粉丝。

sentences.en: And the fact that they could come up to me, and they just always treated me with kindness and as an equal.
sentences.zh: 他们能主动走过来，始终以友善的态度对待我，把我当作平等的人，这一点我永远、永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: And that's something I will never, ever forget.
sentences.zh: 这一点我永远、永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: And I say they, but I realize it's you, you guys.
sentences.zh: 我说的是“他们”，但我意识到其实就是你们，你们大家。

sentences.en: So thanks for being so nice.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你这么客气。

sentences.en: You know, lady, it's so sweet for him to say that.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，女士，他能这么说真是太贴心了。

sentences.en: And it really takes me back because when I was an aspiring actor and I would get those guest star roles on shows, it would be such a big deal to me.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我回想起过去，当我还是个怀揣梦想的演员时，能得到那些客串角色的机会，对我来说真的是件大事。

sentences.en: But I would go on the set, and I would feel just so alone.
sentences.zh: 但我去片场的时候，总会感到非常孤独。

sentences.en: And most of the time, people didn't invite me to eat lunch with them.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，人们都不会邀请我一起吃午饭。

sentences.en: And they were in their own world because they had that job every day, so it wasn't particularly special to them.
sentences.zh: 他们沉浸在自己的世界里，因为他们每天都有那份工作，所以对他们来说这没什么特别的。

sentences.en: And I would just feel, you know, like I was really on my own.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的感觉，你知道的，就像我是一个人孤军奋战。

sentences.en: We've talked about it, like a kid in a new school on the first day of school.
sentences.zh: 我们聊过这个，就像第一天去新学校的孩子一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, with all the pressure of, like, the new day and the new place and the new work and all of it.
sentences.zh: 没错，带着那种压力，比如新的一天、新的环境、新的工作，所有这些加在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, and people did not generally go out of their way to try to make me feel better.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且大家通常也不会特意去想办法让我感觉好受些。

sentences.en: And that was fine.
sentences.zh: 那也没关系。

sentences.en: But I think all of us on The Office had been knocking around for so long and had experienced that feeling so many times that whenever we did have a guest star,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们《办公室》剧组的所有人都已经在圈子里摸爬滚打很久了，也经历过很多次那种感觉，所以每当我们有客串演员时，

sentences.en: I would watch as everyone would go out of their way to introduce themselves, say hello, shake hands, invite that person to eat lunch with them,
sentences.zh: 我都会看着大家特意去主动做自我介绍、打招呼、握手，邀请那个人一起吃午饭，

sentences.en: show them where the craft services was.
sentences.zh: 带他们去看看剧组的餐饮区在哪里。

sentences.en: I do have this memory of us just being so hospitable.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得我们当时是多么热情好客。

sentences.en: It was like, welcome to our house.
sentences.zh: 就像是，欢迎来到我们的家。

sentences.en: Let's show you around, give you a tour.
sentences.zh: 让我们带你四处看看，给你做个向导。

sentences.en: Do you know where the bathrooms are?
sentences.zh: 你知道洗手间在哪里吗？

sentences.en: And I think it was because all of us had been around for so long, experiencing it the other way, that we wanted our show to be different.
sentences.zh: 我想这是因为我们所有人都已经在圈子里待了很久，经历过那种被冷落的滋味，所以我们希望我们的剧组能有所不同。

sentences.en: And we just did it.
sentences.zh: 我们就是这么做了。

sentences.en: We never talked about it.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没讨论过这件事。

sentences.en: It was just this collective thing that we all did.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们大家共同做的一件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you definitely remember with each job, especially when you're starting out, if there was one person that showed you kindness, you just like remember it and you hold on to it.
sentences.zh: 你肯定记得每一份工作，尤其是刚起步的时候，如果有一个人对你表现出善意，你真的会记住并铭记在心。

sentences.en: And, and I'm so glad that our show was like that for Kevin, you know, and that he took that same philosophy to glee with him.
sentences.zh: 而且，我很高兴我们的剧组对凯文来说就是那样，他也把同样的理念带到了《欢乐合唱团》。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's really cool.
sentences.zh: 是的，那真的很棒。

sentences.en: Well, we also asked him if he, after all this time, still gets recognized as the pizza guy from The Office, even though he's gone on to all these other amazing projects.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们还问过他，时隔这么久，尽管他后来参与了那么多精彩的项目，但他是否还会被认作是《办公室》里的那个披萨小哥。

sentences.en: And here's what he had to say about that.
sentences.zh: 以下是他对此的回答。

sentences.en: The amount of times I get recognized for The Office is mind boggling, truly, like even in the midst of glee, even after glee,
sentences.zh: 我因为《办公室》而被认出来的次数多到令人难以置信，真的，即使是在拍《欢乐合唱团》期间，甚至在《欢乐合唱团》结束后也是如此，

sentences.en: I get recognized a solid quarter of the time from The Office from one single episode.
sentences.zh: 我被认出来的情况中，有四分之一都是因为《办公室》里那唯一的一集。

sentences.en: I did 120 something episodes of Glee, but the one episode I did of The Office, I get recognized that much.
sentences.zh: 我拍了120多集《欢乐合唱团》，但我只拍了一集《办公室》，却被认出来这么多次。

sentences.en: And it's absolutely a different demographic.
sentences.zh: 而且这完全是不同的观众群体。

sentences.en: And you can always tell, but it's still just surprising because I also, I think I look pretty different.
sentences.zh: 你总是能看出来，但这仍然让我感到惊讶，因为我觉得我现在的样子也变了很多。

sentences.en: That was almost 15 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那已经是快15年前的事了。

sentences.en: So I'm always baffled.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是感到困惑。

sentences.en: And it's sort of makes me feel very proud every time.
sentences.zh: 而且每次这都让我感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: I was on that show once.
sentences.zh: 我曾经在那部剧里演过一次。

sentences.en: Well, you know, four days.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，就四天。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I love it.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: Well, I'm glad he had such a great experience on the show.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我很高兴他在那部剧里有这么棒的经历。

sentences.en: And I like that the legacy has endured for him.
sentences.zh: 而且我很高兴这部剧留给他的影响力一直延续至今。

sentences.en: Let us tell you where you can find Kevin.
sentences.zh: 让我们告诉大家在哪里可以找到凯文。

sentences.en: On Instagram, he is just his full name, Kevin McHale.
sentences.zh: 在Instagram上，他的名字就是他的全名，Kevin McHale。

sentences.en: That's Kevin, M-C-H-A-L-E.
sentences.zh: 那是Kevin，M-C-H-A-L-E。

sentences.en: And on Twitter, he is Druid Dude.
sentences.zh: 在Twitter上，他是Druid Dude。

sentences.en: D-R-U-I-D-D-U-D-E.
sentences.zh: 德-鲁-伊-老-哥。

sentences.en: Well, now, Angela, we have my other favorite scene from this episode coming up with you
sentences.zh: 好了，安吉拉，接下来我们要播放这一集中我最喜欢的另一个片段，

sentences.en: in it again.
sentences.zh: 里面也有你。

sentences.en: I love that scene with you and Michael where he's giving you all of the instructions.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢你和迈克尔的那场戏，就是他给你交代所有指令的那段。

sentences.en: And I love when Andy comes over to serenade Angela over speakerphone with his acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 我也很喜欢安迪带着他的阿卡贝拉伙伴们，通过免提电话给安吉拉唱小夜曲的那段。

sentences.en: This was so...
sentences.zh: 那段真是……

sentences.en: Did you say acapella pals?
sentences.zh: 你刚才说阿卡贝拉伙伴？

sentences.en: Acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 阿卡贝拉伙伴。

sentences.en: Acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 阿卡贝拉伙伴。

sentences.en: His acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 他的阿卡贝拉伙伴。

sentences.en: His acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 他的阿卡贝拉伙伴。

sentences.en: Aca what?
sentences.zh: 阿卡什么？

sentences.en: My acapella pals.
sentences.zh: 我的阿卡贝拉伙伴。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This scene was so much fun to do.
sentences.zh: 拍那场戏真的特别有意思。

sentences.en: And oh my gosh, more went into it than you'll know.
sentences.zh: 天哪，你们根本不知道那场戏背后付出了多少努力。

sentences.en: I mean, it was pretty like a tech heavy moment.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那算是一个技术含量很高的时刻。

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 那确实。

sentences.en: Well, we actually asked Jen, how did she come up with this idea for the serenade?
sentences.zh: 我们其实问过简，她是怎么想到这个小夜曲的点子的？

sentences.en: Or how did she pitch this idea?
sentences.zh: 或者说她是怎么提出这个想法的？

sentences.en: Because this was brilliant and so charming.
sentences.zh: 因为这真的太天才、太迷人了。

sentences.en: And here's what she had to say.
sentences.zh: 以下是她的回答。

sentences.en: I remember pitching to Greg that Andy could sing, take a chance on me to Angela with speakerphone
sentences.zh: 我记得当时向格雷格提议，让安迪通过免提电话给安吉拉唱《Take a Chance on Me》，

sentences.en: backup singers.
sentences.zh: 还要有伴唱。

sentences.en: And Greg was like, cool, cool.
sentences.zh: 格雷格当时说，酷，酷。

sentences.en: Go tell Ed so we can start thinking about how he'd want to sing it.
sentences.zh: 去告诉艾德，这样我们就能开始构思他想怎么唱了。

sentences.en: And I walked down to Ed's trailer and I'm just awkward in general.
sentences.zh: 我走到艾德的拖车前，我这人本来就挺笨拙的。

sentences.en: But then also I had a bit of a fangirl thing because I loved Ed on The Daily Show and I was
sentences.zh: 而且当时我还有点小粉丝心态，因为我超爱看艾德在《每日秀》里的表现，

sentences.en: still so excited that he was on The Office.
sentences.zh: 他能来《办公室》演戏我到现在还很激动。

sentences.en: So I just awkwardly knocked on his trailer door and told him, hey, we're thinking about
sentences.zh: 所以我笨手笨脚地敲了他的拖车门，告诉他，嘿，我们打算让安迪给安吉拉唱首《Take a Chance on Me》。

sentences.en: having Andy sing, take a chance on me to Angela.
sentences.zh: 我们只是想让你先琢磨一下这首歌。

sentences.en: And we just wanted you to start thinking about the song.
sentences.zh: 他问，什么歌？

sentences.en: He's like, what song?
sentences.zh: 我说，《Take a Chance on Me》。

sentences.en: I said, take a chance on me.
